topic: Data extraction and session copying for analysis
summary_markdown: The discussion focused on data requirements for analyzing virtual sensor data from a tractor 7930. Specifically, [p1] requested the copying of `device_session_concept` sessions and all other necessary tables containing data starting from October 1st. [me] confirmed that the session data for September and October is currently being transferred from slow to fast storage and will be copied immediately upon completion. The priority was established as the sensor data extraction, which is more urgent than demographic analysis.
decisions: Session data must be copied starting from October 1st for company 7930.
action_items: [me] to copy required session data and tables starting from October 1st.
[p1] to provide clarification if needed regarding the scope of the required data.
